description: Defines the OperatorPanelButton class, a custom toggle button control with properties for Text, Glyph, font sizes, and an associated Flyout menu, used within a calculator application's UI.

classes.name: OperatorPanelButton
classes.description: A sealed class extending ToggleButton, providing custom properties and behavior for operator buttons in the calculator UI.

methods.name: OnApplyTemplate
methods.description: Overrides method to attach event handler to FlyoutMenu's Closed event.

methods.name: OnToggle
methods.description: Overrides method to show the Flyout menu when toggled on.

methods.name: FlyoutClosed
methods.description: Event handler to set IsChecked to false when the Flyout menu is closed.
